title: Nondeterministic run agrees with deterministic run
statement: Let $M$ be an oracle Turing machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes, let $O$ be an oracle language, let $w$ be a finite list of Boolean choices, and let $c$ be a configuration with $k+1$ work tapes. Running the nondeterministic machine obtained from $M$ on $O$ using the choice list $w$ from $c$ gives the same configuration as running $M$ on $O$ from $c$ for exactly the length of $w$ steps.
hypotheses_covered: An oracle machine with $k$ ordinary work tapes
